A '''''vhe'viin''''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of small [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. While the quick-moving ''vhe'viin'' was a burrowing creature most often seen covered in coats of [[Color/Legends|tan]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]], ''vhe'viine'' were known to change the color of their fur to white when living amidst a [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered region. The tiny rodents were a common sight on Mandalore, and developed a reputation for infiltrating fields of [[Grain/Legends|grain]] in large groups, feeding on an unlucky [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Farm/Legends|farmer's]] [[Bas neral|crop]].

==Biology and appearance==
A species of small, [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]], ''vhe'viine'' were [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="Revelation" /> located in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The tiny creatures were blanketed in a pelt of [[Color/Legends|tan]]-colored [[Hair/Legends|fur]]<ref name="Revelation" /> that turned white in [[Winter/Legends|winter]] to better allow the ''vhe'viine'' to blend with [[Water/Legends|snow]] on the ground. ''Vhe'viine'' were burrowing animals that displayed a curious disposition toward their environment,<ref name="O66" /> and had a dietary preference for [[Grain/Legends|grain]], which put them at odds with [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] who grew the crop.<ref name="Revelation" />

==History==
Over [[Time/Legends|time]], ''vhe'viine'' developed a reputation for invading the fields of Mandalorian farmers in packs, stealing grain from their crop for their own consumption.<ref name="Revelation" /> A number of ''vhe'viine'' lived around the vicinity of the [[Clan Skirata|Skirata clan]] home, [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Kyrimorut]], and a group of the curious creatures bared witness to the reconciliation of Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] and his daughter, [[Ruusaan Skirata|Ruusaan]].<ref name="O66" /> The members of Clan Skirata also carved a number of toys out of [[veshok]] [[Tree/Legends|wood]] for a young [[Venku Skirata]], and included among them was a toy ''vhe'viin''.<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[41 ABY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] journeyed to Mandalore to seek the aid of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in defeating her brother, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]], after he turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and became a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. When she was taken to meet Fett at the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in Mandalore's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], Solo came across a ''vhe'viin'' scurrying over the floor of the ancient [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]]. Not long after, Fett encounted another ''vhe'viin'' while visiting the headquarters of [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]], and noted that with the period of economic resurgence the planet had been enjoying, the ''vhe'viine'' living around Mandalore's farming areas were able to capitalize on the farmers' prosperity for themselves, pilfering [[Bas neral|grain]] from the fields.<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''vhe'viin'' rodent was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in eighth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel series, [[Legacy of the Force: Revelation|''Revelation'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[February 26]], [[2008]].<ref name="Revelation" /> Traviss would again feature the ''vhe'viin'' again her fourth entry into the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' novel series]], [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], later that year.<ref name="O66" /> The ''vhe'viin'' also appeared briefly in the sequel to ''Order 66'', entitled ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', wherein it was featured as a wooden toy.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />
